name: Playhouse 90
description: Playhouse 90 is an American television anthology series that was telecast on CBS from 1956 to 1960 for a total of 133 episodes. It originated from CBS Television City in Los Angeles, California. Since live anthology drama series of the mid-1950s were usually hour-long shows, the title highlighted the network's intention to present something unusual, a weekly series of hour-and-a-half dramas rather than 60-minute plays. Playhouse 90 began as a pitch by Frank Stanton—the formidable, forward-thinking right-hand man to CBS chairman William S. Paley—during a brainstorming session for program ideas. The project was ultimately developed by Hubbell Robinson, a CBS vice president who received no screen credit on Playhouse 90 but is often described as its creator.

videos.title: Forbidden Area
videos.overview: Why are so many B-99 bombers from Hibiscus Air Base crashing or simply disappearing? Colonel Price comes up with a terrifying explanation, but will anyone believe him?

videos.title: Requiem for a Heavyweight
videos.overview: An over-the-hill heavyweight boxing champion who suffers from the ravages of years of head trauma is exploited by his manager, despite the efforts of a compassionate young woman who tries to help him recover his self-respect.

videos.title: Sizeman and Son
videos.overview: The happy atmosphere in Mr. Sizeman's factory is disrupted by an argumentative newcomer - his son.

videos.title: Rendezvous in Black
videos.overview: A woman is inexplicably killed on a street-corner. What has this to do with other deaths around the city?

videos.title: The Country Husband
videos.overview: After a near-death experience, a businessman starts to re-think his life, and wonders about leaving his wife.

videos.title: The Big Slide
videos.overview: A vaudeville comic becomes a silent film star.

videos.title: Heritage of Anger
videos.overview: A wealthy industrialist has trouble with his sons.

videos.title: Eloise
videos.overview: It's not so much that Eloise is a mischievous child, but the darnedest things do happen when she's around.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: When a much-admired community leader dies, a journalist starts to investigate his life - and finds he was not the man he seemed.

videos.title: Made in Heaven
videos.overview: When Zachary and Elsa separate, each seems tempted to start a new love affair.

videos.title: Sincerely, Willis Wade
videos.overview: A wealthy mill owner finances the education of a clever, but poor, young man.

videos.title: The Family Nobody Wanted
videos.overview: A true story, it follows a pastor and his wife through forties beginning with one biological child, Donny. But the upheaval of the war years results in a number of mixed raced children that the Doss family adopt until they have 12 children.

videos.title: Massacre at Sand Creek
videos.overview: An investigation into a massacre of Native Americans.

videos.title: Snowshoes: A Comedy of People and Horses
videos.overview: Some racetrack Johnnies are talking between races when one wonders if you can hypnotize a horse into thinking it's a champion. The idea sets in motion a series of hilarious events.

videos.title: The Ninth Day
videos.overview: Events in the aftermath of World War Three.

videos.title: So Soon to Die
videos.overview: Down on his luck, war hero Lionel Amblin contemplates committing a murder.

videos.title: The Star Wagon
videos.overview: An inventor, pondering on how he might differently have arranged his life, invents a time machine and decides to make a few changes.

videos.title: The Greer Case
videos.overview: When a rich woman dies without signing her new will, all kinds of problems ensue.

videos.title: The Miracle Worker
videos.overview: The story of Anne Sullivan's struggle to teach the blind and deaf Helen Keller how to communicate.

videos.title: The Comedian
videos.overview: Sammy Hogarth, a vaudeville comedian who now has his own TV show, is a ruthless egomaniac who demands instant obedience from his staff and heaps abuse on those in lesser positions than his. His most vituperative behavior, however, is reserved for his weak-willed brother, Lester, whom Sammy has hired as his assistant but whom he really uses as his whipping boy.

videos.title: One Coat of White
videos.overview: A newly-widowed woman goes on a trip to Europe and meets a French artist.

videos.title: The Blackwell Story
videos.overview: In the 19th century, Elizabeth Blackwell determines to become a doctor.

videos.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
videos.overview: A gunfighter is terrorizing a small western town. The townspeople finally pool their money to a hire another gunfighter to drive him out of town. The townsfolk thought they had it bad until they handed the reigns over to the new terror. Pooling their money again, this time to hire Jeffers to get rid of Dancer.

videos.title: The Last Tycoon
videos.overview: A movie producer is slowly working himself to death.

videos.title: The Hostess with the Mostes'
videos.overview: The story of Perle Mesta, who became, first, a renowned society hostess, and then an ambassadress.

videos.title: Where's Charley?
videos.overview: Lord Fancourt Babberley is forced to disguise himself as a woman - his aunt from Brazil, "where the nuts come from".

videos.title: Clipper Ship
videos.overview: A romance on the high seas revolving around the comely widow of a shipping magnate, and her growing love for a handsome young political prisoner who was scheduled to be put to death when the vessel reached its destination. Though unyielding at first, the ship's stern captain eventually helped the woman to make a clean getaway, with the condemned man in tow.

videos.title: Three Men on a Horse
videos.overview: A meek salesman with an uncanny ability to pick horses is virtually kidnapped by a trio of gamblers.

videos.title: Four Women in Black
videos.overview: Four nuns, led by Sister Teresa, begin a treacherous journey across the Arizona desert in 1870. Their faith enables them to deal with the challenges of nature and the hostility of their fellow mankind.

videos.title: Homeward Borne
videos.overview: Just after World War Two ends, an American woman takes in a Polish war orphan boy, a concentration camp survivor. But conflict arises when her husband, a returning Air Force bomber pilot, hates the boy and his psychological baggage.

videos.title: The Helen Morgan Story
videos.overview: Broadway legend Helen Morgan 's life as told by her mother, from her early start in second rate speakeasies to star of top rated shows and owning her own club. Also seen is her poor choices, such as her affair with a married man, her short marriage to a much younger man, a court fight over an adopted baby and her fatal descent into booze addiction.

videos.title: Circle of the Day
videos.overview: On her tenth wedding anniversary (which is also her daughter's birthday), a wife begins to suspect her husband of unfaithfulness.

videos.title: Without Incident
videos.overview: Captain Russell Bidlack, commander of a U.S. Cavalry unit in 1870, determines to complete a rescue mission through dangerous Indian territory. In the course of the mission, he rescues the wives of two slain traders and captures the Indian chief accused of the murders. When he returns to the fort, he's faced with a revolt among his own men.

videos.title: Clash by Night
videos.overview: Mae Doyle comes back to her hometown a cynical woman. Her brother Joe fears that his love, fish cannery worker Peggy, may wind up like Mae. Mae marries Jerry and has a baby; she is happy but restless, drawn to Jerry's friend Earl.

videos.title: Ain't No Time for Glory
videos.overview: American soldiers must use stealth to take over a German command post in Normandy.

videos.title: The Fabulous Irishman
videos.overview: Romanticized life story of Robert Briscoe, the first Jewish Lord Mayor of Dublin.

videos.title: The Death of Manolete
videos.overview: The last hours in the life of Spain's most celebrated matador.

videos.title: The Dark Side of the Earth
videos.overview: A drama set in 1956, during the unsuccessful Hungarian uprising against the Russians

videos.title: Topaze
videos.overview: A mild-mannered schoolteacher gradually abandons all his principles - and finds the success which has always hitherto eluded him.

videos.title: A Sound of Different Drummers
videos.overview: In a dystopian society, reading is forbidden.

videos.title: The Playroom
videos.overview: When a mother wins an award, she finds out a few things about her three grown-up children.

videos.title: Around the World in 90 Minutes
videos.overview: October 17, 1957, the CBS Television Network diverted from its typical format of live dramatic presentations for "Playhouse 90" to cover Michael Todd's gigantic party commemorating the one-year anniversary of the release of his film "Around The World In 80 Days". Todd invited 18-thousand people to the gala in New York City's Madison Square Garden though the number probably was far greater because of party-crashers. Walter Cronkite hosted the coverage with future ABC Sports ace Jim McKay and news veteran Bill Leonard handling the interviewing of numerous celebrity party guests. During the broadcast, Garry Moore hosted occasional comedy vignettes of how Todd came to create his Academy award-winning movie.

videos.title: The Mystery of Thirteen
videos.overview: The story of William Palmer, one of the most notorious poisoners in Victorian England - or was he?

videos.title: The Edge of Innocence
videos.overview: A lawyer's new brother-in-law disapproves of his specialty of defending murderers. But when he finds himself accused of murder, he asks for his help.

videos.title: The Jet-Propelled Couch
videos.overview: Based on a case history in psychologist Dr. Robert Linder's book "The 50-Minute Hour." Unbeknownst to his friends and colleagues, the outwardly sane and secure atomic physicist Dr. Kirk Allen has for many years been embarking upon imaginary visits to another planet. At first this mental abnormality harms no one, but when Allen begins acting strangely on the job, the Pentagon begins to suspect that he is a security risk. Under psychological counseling, Allen reveals his "secret life" and provides surprisingly accurate extraterrestrial charts as "proof" that he is truly out of this world.

videos.title: Panic Button
videos.overview: A Civil Aeronautics Board investigation determines that the reason a plane crashed, killing all aboard except one of the pilots, is that either the dead pilot or the survivor became panic-stricken and pushed the wrong button, but the investigators aren't sure which one was at fault.

videos.title: Galvanized Yankee
videos.overview: In a Northern prisoner-of-war camp during the Civil War, a crippled Yankee commander has a rebellious Rebel executed. The dead man's brother, also a prisoner, vows vengeance. He volunteers to accompany the commander on a mission, planning to murder him along the way but changes his mind and escapes instead, deciding the commander is "already dead." The commander, a changed man, covers up for the escapees and himself faces court martial.

videos.title: The Thundering Wave
videos.overview: Middle-aged actress Victoria Maxwell comes to terms with her destructive lifestyle as she struggles with the lead role in a Broadway-bound play. Matters are complicated by the fact that she is co-starring opposite her estranged husband, Allen Grant, whom she never stopped loving.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: A reunion party for old army buddies turns inexorably into something darker and more sinister.

videos.title: The 80 Yard Run
videos.overview: Long ago, Christian made a run of 80 yards to make the winning touchdown in a football game. It was the greatest moment of his life. Or was it the beginning of his decline?

videos.title: Before I Die
videos.overview: An innocent man, doomed to die for the murder of a cop that he didn't commit, is rushed from prison to the county hospital for an emergency operation. The surgeon becomes convinced of the man's innocence when he mumbles a girl's name under anesthesia. The surgeon seeks the help of a psychiatrist to penetrate his patient's subconscious.

videos.title: The Gentleman from Seventh Avenue
videos.overview: Mr. Golden wonders if he has wasted his life; but the news that he is to become a grandfather cheers him.

videos.title: The Violent Heart
videos.overview: Photographer Paul is invited to a French estate to take pictures but a romance develops with the lady of the house. A sudden death creates a suspicion of murder.

videos.title: No Time at All
videos.overview: An airliner flying nonstop at night from Miami to New York fails to check in, then disappears from radar. We see how its disappearance affects people on the ground. The Episode was directed by David Swift, who also collaborated with Charles Einstein with the screenplay. Charles Einstein is also credited with writing the story. Guests include William Lundigan, Betsy Palmer, Jane Greer, Buster Keaton, Chico Marx, Frank Wilcox & Charles Bronson. The Production Company was CBS Television Network and was distributed in the USA by CBS.

videos.title: Point of No Return
videos.overview: Waiting to find out if he's obtained a valuable promotion, a banker returns to the small town he grew up in.

videos.title: Portrait of a Murderer
videos.overview: Based on a true story, Donald Bashor robs and bludgeons two women to their deaths. While committing the crimes he maintains a normal existence with his girlfriend Florry.

videos.title: The Last Clear Chance
videos.overview: A veteran lawyer must defend his own son when the latter is threatened with disbarment.

videos.title: The Male Animal
videos.overview: The trustees of Midwestern University have forced three teachers out of their jobs for being suspected communists. Trustee Ed Keller has also threatened mild mannered English Professor Tommy Turner, because he plans to read a controversial piece of prose in class.

videos.title: The Right Hand Man
videos.overview: The story of a struggle for control of a Hollywood talent agency.

videos.title: Verdict of Three
videos.overview: A murder trial is followed through different jurors and their reactions.

videos.title: Nightmare at Ground Zero
videos.overview: After the first atom bomb test, scientists realize the bomb was more powerful than they expected - which may have terrible results.

videos.title: Bomber's Moon
videos.overview: A hard-hearted Colonel loses many men in his group's bombing missions over World War II Germany, but keeps on going and won't tolerate a young lieutenant losing his nerve under the strain, who refuses to continue.

videos.title: Natchez
videos.overview: A Civil War veteran returns home to find his father has become a social pariah.

videos.title: The Innocent Sleep
videos.overview: When a rich man marries a much younger wife and his ailing health gets rather worse, the housekeeper suspects a murder attempt is looming.

videos.title: A Town Has Turned to Dust
videos.overview: A weakling sheriff is unable to prevent a lynching. Can he redeem himself by preventing a second one?

videos.title: The Great Gatsby
videos.overview: A Midwesterner becomes fascinated with his wealthy neighbor, who obsesses over his lost love.

videos.title: Bitter Heritage
videos.overview: The James boys, being framed for a bank heist, are saved by the banker's daughter.

videos.title: The Plot to Kill Stalin
videos.overview: In late 1952, an aging and increasingly paranoid Stalin puts in motion a purge against his doctors, with anti-Semitic overtones. His lackeys, including Khrushchev, Molotov and Beria, fear it will spread to the Politburo, and plan to strike first.

videos.title: Days of Wine and Roses
videos.overview: An alcoholic falls in love with and gets married to a young woman, whom he systematically addicts to booze so they can share his "passion" together.

videos.title: The Time of Your Life
videos.overview: William Saroyan's Pulitzer Prize-winning play revolves around the denizens of a San Francisco bar in 1939. Lonely, lovelorn, weary or cynical, the characters drift in and out of the bar and each other's lives, giving voice to Saroyan's philosophies as they randomly comment about the impending world war, the beauty of art, and traditional notions of good and evil.

videos.title: Shadows Tremble
videos.overview: An elderly immigrant tries to buy an old house in New England and is opposed by snobbish locals.

videos.title: Word from a Sealed-Off Box
videos.overview: A courier for the Dutch Resistance is captured by the Nazis.

videos.title: Heart of Darkness
videos.overview: A trading company manager travels up an African river to find a missing outpost head and discovers the depth of evil in humanity's soul.

videos.title: Old Man
videos.overview: To fight a Mississippi flood in 1927, a prison farm releases some convicts.

videos.title: The Return of Ansel Gibbs
videos.overview: After years in retirement, Ansel Gibbs is asked to return to government service.

videos.title: Seven Against the Wall
videos.overview: The story of the infamous St. Valentine's Day Massacre of 1929.

videos.title: The Nutcracker
videos.overview: This telecast of George Balanchine's famous production was broadcast only four years after it was premiered by the New York City Ballet. This was the only episode of the series televised in color.

videos.title: The Wings of the Dove
videos.overview: An impoverished woman who has been forced to choose between a privileged life with her wealthy aunt and her journalist lover, befriends an American heiress. When she discovers the heiress is attracted to her own lover and is dying, she sees a chance to have both the privileged life she cannot give up and the lover she cannot live without.

videos.title: The Velvet Alley
videos.overview: Ernie Pandish has tried to be a writer for years and has never made much money out of it. But now he seems likely to hit the big-time.

videos.title: A Quiet Game of Cards
videos.overview: A few friends meet each weekend for a quiet game of cards. But they're bored with poker and, in trying to find another diversion, gradually find themselves plotting a hypothetical murder. It is hypothetical, isn't it?

videos.title: Child of Our Time
videos.overview: War deprives Tanguy of his childhood. When his mother returns to Spain to oppose the Franco regime, he is left in Nazi-occupied Marseilles, France.

videos.title: The Raider
videos.overview: A corporate raider plans a hostile takeover. To stall him, pressure is put on a scientist to rush through a new type of engine before all necessary tests have been completed.

videos.title: The Ding-A-Ling Girl
videos.overview: A housewife is offered a Hollywood contract. She'd rather stay home, but her husband has ambitions for her.

videos.title: Made in Japan
videos.overview: A young soldier in occupied Japan after World War II falls in love with a lovely Japanese girl, but is horrified about what his prejudiced family in Philadelphia will think if he takes her home with him.

videos.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls: Part 1
videos.overview: During the Spanish Civil War, an American allied with the Republicans finds romance during a desperate mission to blow up a strategically important bridge.

videos.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls: Part 2
videos.overview: The completion of the mission has tragic consequences.

videos.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
videos.overview: In the later stages of the Nuremberg Trials, four German judges are accused of perverting the course of justice.

videos.title: Dark December
videos.overview: During World War II, an army doctor struggles to convert a Franciscan monastery into a field hospital.

videos.title: Diary of a Nurse
videos.overview: The daily emergencies and stresses of a major city's hospital ward as seen through the eyes of nurse Gail Lucas.

videos.title: A Marriage of Strangers
videos.overview: Marry in haste, repent at leisure? Well, maybe.

videos.title: Out of Dust
videos.overview: On a cattle drive across the prairie, the sons of a wealthy cattle baron plot his death.

videos.title: The Rank and File
videos.overview:
A powerful union leader is interrogated by a Senate committee. Testifying before a Senate, William Kilcoyne tells the story of

his career. He began as a factory worker and his shrewdness and ambition

carried him up through the ranks to his present position as head of a large union.

videos.title: The Killers of Mussolini
videos.overview: As the Salo Republic crumbles around him, Mussolini, along with his mistress and several of his ministers flee with retreating Nazi soldiers, but are caught at the town of Dongo by red partisans. All are brutally executed without trial.

videos.title: Project Immortality
videos.overview: Key defense scientist Doner has cancer. Schramm is assigned to code Doner's thinking into a computer. He gets to know him as a friend, a husband and father. The project is successful, but he now knows identity is not programmable.

videos.title: Dark as the Night
videos.overview: A British politician finds himself open to blackmail because of the indiscretion of his American wife.

videos.title: The Second Happiest Day
videos.overview: A man about to be married recalls the day his life changed permanently.

videos.title: Target for Three
videos.overview: Three conspirators plan the death of a South American head of state.

videos.title: The Sounds of Eden
videos.overview: Three different viewpoints of the same story - a kidnapping and its aftermath.

videos.title: Misalliance
videos.overview: A group of people gathered at a wealthy man's country home on a summer weekend engage in an exploration of their varied romantic entanglements.

videos.title: The Hidden Image
videos.overview: A journalist out to expose political corruption finds his family is in danger.

videos.title: The Grey Nurse Said Nothing
videos.overview: In Australia, a landowner is arrested for murder - but where's the body?

videos.title: The Tunnel
videos.overview: In the Civil War, a tunnel is dug under Confederate lines, and filled with explosives.

videos.title: The Silver Whistle
videos.overview: The old people's home is a pretty miserable place - until the arrival of the mysterious Mr. Erwenter.

videos.title: John Brown's Raid
videos.overview: The story of abolitionist John Brown's raid on Harper's Ferry.

videos.title: A Dream of Treason
videos.overview: A State Department official is required to leak a confidential document - which may have terrible repercussions.

videos.title: To the Sound of Trumpets
videos.overview: In Paris, a former soldier is alarmed when the girl he has fallen in love with demonstrates a rather naïve and romanticized attitude to war.

videos.title: The Cruel Day
videos.overview: Violence and brutality greet a French Army captain when he arrives in Algeria to assume command of a remote outpost. He is appalled by the savage massacre of an Algerian family by the Rebels. When the French take a prisoner who knows the names of Rebel leaders, the captain is told that torture is the only way to make him talk. Then the captain meets the prisoner - a handsome, intelligent teenage boy.

videos.title: Tomorrow
videos.overview: Slow witted, and tired, Fentry leads a lonely life of grinding poverty in his sharecropper's shack until a sick, pregnant woman escaping her abusive husband comes there. He takes her in and cares for her, eventually falling in love with her.

videos.title: The Hiding Place
videos.overview: In the last days of World War II, two English airmen are captured by an ordinary German citizen, who, instead of handing them over to the authorities, keeps them prisoner in his cellar, neglecting to tell them when the war ends.

videos.title: Alas, Babylon
videos.overview: Americans try to cope with the aftermath of a nuclear catastrophe.

videos.title: Journey to the Day
videos.overview: Patients at a mental hospital meet for a group therapy session.

videos.title: The Shape of the River
videos.overview: Determined to pay off his debts, Mark Twain sets off on a lecture tour.

videos.title: In the Presence of Mine Enemies
videos.overview: In the Warsaw ghetto, a Jewish man seeks revenge for the rape of his sister by a German soldier.

awards: Won 13 Primetime Emmys. 19 wins & 36 nominations total
